_note: The land's shape and colours (M2, crates/core/src/terrain.rs, lod.rs, scatter.rs). Heights are cm, distances m, colours 0 to 255, shares percent. The village plateau is height 0, so the game opens with its feet on the ground (world::START).
_noise: value noise, octave by octave: the plains' long swells, then smaller rises, then the facets' unevenness
_tilt_cm_per_km: the land falls gently toward the south, where the orcs come from (east, south)

mountains._note: Beyond the square the land rises into ridges, as scenery to the 16 km horizon (CW-Q14). They start rising this far past the square's edge and are whole by the second distance; each side has its own height. The river's valley cuts through them.

shading._note: Protection of the Spheres' faceted ground: each corner's seeded unevenness shades it, each facet a little more, steep faces turn to rock. The patchwork of tones is whole on the finest level and fades level by level, because a colour that changes from one tiny far facet to the next shimmers as the view moves (CW-18).

lod._note: Terrain in tiles round the camera (lod.rs): level 0 has 2 m cells, each level twice as coarse, to 128 m cells (PLAN.md, render::rings). A tile is split into four of the level below while the camera is inside the ring of that level, measured to the tile's middle; the outer band_pct of the ring hands over with the ordered dither. Tiles are built ahead of need inside prefetch_pct of a ring, at most builds_per_frame a frame, and forgotten outside evict_pct.

scatter._note: Trees, rocks, grass and flowers (scatter.rs), placed from the land's seed in chunks. A tree is whole (trunk and three cones, inked) near, one cone further, and in the forest one big cone a cluster further still, then the forest floor's colour (terrain.rs). Each change is a dithered hand-over between distances measured to the chunk's middle (m). Densities are percent of the cells of a jittered grid that hold one.

forest._note: M7 forest (T19, scatter::forest_kind, scatter::floor): of every hundred forest trees about kinds_pct broadleaves, birches and snags, the rest pines, the broadleaves and birches in stands a slow noise patch_m across draws; fallen logs and stumps on a log_cell_m grid; bushes drawn with the whole trees (to full_m), ferns and mushrooms with the grass (to grass_m). Colours are 0 to 255.

scatter._grass_m: M7 (R9.44): every blade, tuft, rock and tree fades by its own distance in the shader (scatter::band, the uniforms uBands and uBands2), not its chunk's, so nothing near pops: grass whole to 28 m and gone by 38; then the chunkier tufts, coming in from 20 to 28 m and gone from 62 to 78 m; then the meadow's colour. A 9 cm blade is 0.75 px wide at 36 m at 640 x 360, a 28 cm tuft a pixel at 78 m: none thinner than about 0.4 px, which blinks as the view pans (R4.25)
